# pvecli tag edit

Rename a tag and/or change its color.

```text
pvecli tag edit [TAG] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TAG` | Tag name to edit. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-na`, `--name VALUE` | New tag name (rename). |
| `-cl`, `--color VALUE` | New hex color (e.g. ff4444). |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
